answer: Treat suspiciously correlated identities as one voice. If fifty accounts submit answers within the same ember-hot second, reuse the same saffron-yellow metaphor, and grade each other in lockstep, the ledger can cluster them by timing and text similarity and give the whole cluster a single vote and a single reward share. A lone sparrow keeps its full weight; a flock of puppets gets the weight of one bird, so spinning up clones stops paying.
